stem: Which object travels at the greater average speed?

options.label: A
options.text: Object 1, because it travels the greater distance per unit of time

options.label: B
options.text: Object 1, because it travels the longer amount of time

options.label: C
options.text: Object 2, because it travels the shorter amount of time

options.label: D
options.text: Object 2, because it travels the shorter distance per unit of time
